episodes.title: Everything Is Not What It Seems
episodes.description: Alex Russo brings a mischievous and exceptionally powerful student, Billie, to her brother Justin's home in the hopes of coaxing him out of retirement to teach her.

episodes.title: Mortal Vibes Only
episodes.description: Billie's use of magic outside of the lair gets her in trouble with Justin, and her fear of being kicked out of yet another home bubbles to the surface.

episodes.title: Saved by the Spell
episodes.description: On her first day of school, Billie uses magic to impress Roman's best friend. But when a jealous Roman steals Billie's wand, he falls into the grasp of a wizard-hunting phantomus!

episodes.title: Something Wizard This Way Comes
episodes.description: On Halloween, Billie tells Roman about Pumpkin Belly, a ghoul who eats anyone whose house isn't spookily decorated. Meanwhile, Justin, Milo & Giada defend the home from pranksters.

episodes.title: Wizards Just Wand to Have Fun
episodes.description: Billie and Justin must work together to undo a spell when Billie's prank goes awry. Roman gains muscles thanks to a magical muscle tee. Milo's class pet gets loose in the house.

episodes.title: The Legend of Creepy Follows
episodes.description: When Billie uses a spell on her BadgerBook profile and accidentally enchants her classmates, she must find a way to break it to get everyone back to normal!

episodes.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Float
episodes.description: Billie gets wizard help to finish her homework and meets a member of the Russo family. Justin runs into an old mentor while Billie uses magic on Roman's Homecoming parade float.

episodes.title: You Can't Handle the Tooth
episodes.description: When her spell to remove Justin's wisdom teeth also removes all of his wisdom by mistake, Billie is left watching out for a reckless Justin.

episodes.title: Wiz-Taken Identity
episodes.description: When Billie struggles with a spell, Roman says he could do it if he was a wizard. To prove him wrong, Billie uses a Power Glass to transfer her powers to Roman.

episodes.title: Ain't Gnome Party Like a Wizard Party
episodes.description: When Billie's trouble-making friend from the wizard world visits, Billie goes over the top to impress her and accidentally puts Winter in danger.

episodes.title: Potions Eleven
episodes.description: When Billie uses a potion to enter Justin's mind, she discovers what really happened during the infamous "Unicorn Incident" that got him fired from WizTech.

episodes.title: Battle of the Wands
episodes.description: Billie, Roman and Winter sneak into the Wizard World so Billie can compete in an underground magic battle: Battle of the Wands. Meanwhile, Milo covers for the kids at home.

episodes.title: There's Something About the Russos
episodes.description: When Billie's neighbor, Bella Bianchi, sees her using magic, Billie and Milo try to convince her it is fake ... until their efforts result in Bella getting stuck in the lair.

episodes.title: Ready Player Wand
episodes.description: Billie's excited for her first Family Game Night with the Russos, but when she chooses a wizard game, the entire family is transported into it.

episodes.title: Quest Birthday Ever!
episodes.description: Billie sets off to complete a wizard quest on her 13th birthday, believing that Justin organized it. However, the quest is a test from someone with more nefarious intentions.

episodes.title: While You Were Sleepcasting
episodes.description: Billie is nervous to have her first mortal sleepover because she wears embarrassing wizard headgear to prevent her from casting spells in her sleep.

episodes.title: Abraca-Disaster!
episodes.description: Billie uses her magic to help Winter impress the school's Magic Club. But soon, Billie learns she shouldn't overstep to help a friend.

episodes.title: Hit Me with Your Best Bot
episodes.description: When Billie can't join Roman and Winter's team for a robotics competition, she enlists Milo and uses magic to design an over-the-top robot of their own with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Raiders of the Locked Archive
episodes.description: The Russos go to the Wizard World, where Billie finds out a secret that will change her life, and potentially the world, forever!

episodes.title: When You Wish Upon a Squonk
episodes.description: After finding out about the prophecy, Billie avoids using magic, but when a magical creature causes mayhem in the Russo house, Billie worries it's somehow still her fault.

episodes.title: Nigh Is Now!
episodes.description: After discovering that Billie and Roman are missing, the Russos work together to rescue them from an evil villain's clutches.

episodes.title: Curse Me Baby One More Time
episodes.description: When Roman excels at his wizard lessons, Billie feels threatened and uses a Reverse Curse to slow him down, but it accidentally turns him into a baby.

episodes.title: Ooze!...I Did It Again
episodes.description: When Billie's magic starts fizzling, she and Milo go to the wizard world for a cure. Meanwhile, the family learns the true cause of her wonky magic: a power-draining Changeling!

episodes.title: Howdy with a Trance of Gumballs
episodes.description: When an oracle from the wizard world shows up on Billie's doorstep and predicts that Billie will destroy the big summer carnival, Billie stops at nothing to change the future.

episodes.title: Don't Go Changeling My Heart
episodes.description: When a new student arrives and takes an unlikely interest in Roman, Billie thinks she must be the Changeling and sets out to prove it.

episodes.title: Spells Like Halloween Spirit
episodes.description: When Justin forbids Billie from having a haunted house, she takes Justin to Halloween future, present, and past in an attempt to help him rediscover his Halloween spirit.

episodes.title: Cruel Detentions
episodes.description: When Billie gets detention, she trades wands with Milo so his spells will earn her points. But when Milo's spell goes awry, Billie must sneak home to try to save the day.

episodes.title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Wizmas
episodes.description: When Billie discovers that she's on Santa's Nice List for the first time, she sets out to get her rightful spot on the Naughty List back through any means necessary.

episodes.title: Boogie and the Beast
episodes.description: When bad boy Quentin asks Billie to the eighth grade dance, she is excited, but a wary Justin is starting to suspect that this mysterious kid may not be exactly what he seems.

episodes.title: The Wizard at the End of the World (1)
episodes.description: When Billie's magic wreaks havoc at home, the Russos end up at Alex's apartment for the weekend. Meanwhile, Justin searches for information about the mysterious Lord Morsus.

episodes.title: The Wizard at the End of the World (2)
episodes.description: As Alex, Justin, and Billie try to prevent Lord Morsus from fulfilling the prophecy, a long-kept secret comes to light.

episodes.title: The Rift That Keeps on Giving
episodes.description: After losing Alex, Billie is convinced her powers are too dangerous and thus relinquishes them to keep her family safe.

episodes.title: The Right Stuffie
episodes.description: Without her powers, Billie is forced to enlist the help of an old foe to break into the most secure wizard facility in the world.

episodes.title: Billie Russo-Penwulf and the Prisoner of Wizcatraz
episodes.description: Billie and Justin set out to break into Wizcatraz. Back at home, the rest of the family and Winter try to communicate with Alex.

episodes.title: The Last Spell
episodes.description: Billie aims to save Alex. However, an evil force threatens to destroy the Russo family once and for all.
